title: Repository plugin defaults and enterprise plugin controls generally available

title: How to build evidence-grounded agent memory with OpenWiki and Graphs
snippet: LangChain used OpenWiki, its open-source wiki compiler, and an evidence graph to build a persistent memory layer that preserves knowledge for agents to reuse across tasks. Learn how.
